look.theme_amber_desc: A warm accent from the motto orange family.

overlay.align_hint: Alignment has no effect at 100% width — the banner already spans the full width. Shrink it to unlock.
overlay.hint: The overlay is applied to the previewed image — click an image in the gallery or generate a new one.
overlay.margin_hint: Moves the banner inwards from the chosen edge (as a share of the image height).
overlay.offset_hint: Fine-tune from the grid position. It never leaves the image — it stops at the edge.

palette.sheet_desc: Pick a theme colour — matching palettes are generated instantly from colour theory. The palette you choose is added to the generation and edit prompt as colour guidance; it does not affect logo or banner overlays.

settings.foundry_desc: The resource address and key from Azure AI Foundry.
